meta.title: 当你不想在VLOG里露脸时……「大疆Pocket4P」
meta.title_en: When You Don't Want to Show Your Face in a Vlog | DJI Pocket 4P

scenes.context: 不想露脸的方法很多：分屏融合、整体抠出，让你成为环境的一部分。
sentences: 不想在视频里露脸吗？方法太多了。
Don't want to show your face in a video? Plenty of ways.
too many ways（方法太多）
比如像这样把画面变成分屏，让上半部分和你的身体产生有趣的融合。
Like splitting the screen so the upper half fuses playfully with your body.
playful fusion（有趣融合）
或者干脆放弃融合，把整个身体抠出来。
Or skip the fusion and cut your whole body out.
cut out（抠出来）
这样你看起来像是环境中的一部分，也不错。
Then you look like part of the environment—also nice.
part of the environment（环境的一部分）
scenes.speak: Don't want to show your face in a video? Plenty of ways. Like splitting the screen so the upper half fuses playfully with your body. Or skip the fusion and cut your whole body out. Then you look like part of the environment—also nice.

scenes.context: 戴上面具、或用树叶车票等物体挡住脸，还能顺势做个转场。
sentences: 适当的时候还能做个转场，你带上面具了。
At the right moment you can even cut to a mask.
wear a mask（戴面具）
面具足够特别的话，反而更能让观众记住你。
A distinctive mask makes you even more memorable.
memorable（让人记住）
但这只是后期找个东西挡住脸吧。
Or simply cover your face with something in post.
cover the face（挡脸）
树叶、车票、落花，随便是根据你Vlog的主题来变化。
Leaves, tickets, falling petals—pick whatever fits your vlog's theme.
match the theme（贴合主题）
scenes.speak: At the right moment you can even cut to a mask. A distinctive mask makes you even more memorable. Or simply cover your face with something in post. Leaves, tickets, falling petals—pick whatever fits your vlog's theme.

scenes.context: 传统一点：全片拍背影，或者拍脚步，照样有代入感。
sentences: 要么传统一点，转过身去，全片都拍背影。
Or go classic: turn around and shoot your back the whole film.
shoot the back（拍背影）
或者拍脚步也行嘛。
Footsteps work too.
footage of steps（脚步画面）
scenes.speak: Or go classic: turn around and shoot your back the whole film. Footsteps work too.

scenes.title_en: The AI Era and the Benefits of Hiding
scenes.context: AI能改变你的脸，但不露脸的方法和好处都多到爆炸：暂缓容貌焦虑、画面更有创意。
sentences: 但我也知道时代变了，AI早已能让你的脸千变万化。
But times have changed; AI can transform your face endlessly.
transform your face（换脸）
不露脸的方法和好处都多到爆炸。
The tricks and perks of hiding your face are endless.
countless benefits（好处无数）
暂缓容貌焦虑，画面更有创意。
It eases appearance anxiety and boosts creativity.
ease anxiety（暂缓焦虑）
scenes.speak: But times have changed; AI can transform your face endlessly. The tricks and perks of hiding your face are endless. It eases appearance anxiety and boosts creativity.

scenes.context: 相比之下，大方露脸的好处只剩一个：记录下最真实的回忆。
sentences: 相比之下，大方露脸的好处似乎只剩可怜的一个。
In contrast, showing your face has one humble benefit left.
humble benefit（仅剩的好处）
记录下最真实的回忆。
Recording the truest memories.
truest memories（最真实的回忆）
那些大大方方展出来的面孔，能让回忆清晰地浮现。
Only faces you openly showed keep memories vivid.
memories stay vivid（回忆清晰浮现）
那时候一定不会懊悔，只会遗憾拍得不够多。
You'll never regret it then—only wish you'd filmed more.
filmed more（拍得更多）
scenes.speak: In contrast, showing your face has one humble benefit left. Recording the truest memories. Only faces you openly showed keep memories vivid. You'll never regret it then—only wish you'd filmed more.

scenes.context: 结语：拿起相机，把镜头对向自己，为未来留下真实的自己。
sentences: 那么现在，拿起它，把镜头对向自己吧。
So now, pick it up and point the lens at yourself.
point the lens（对准镜头）
scenes.speak: So now, pick it up and point the lens at yourself.

practice: Split the screen so the top half fuses with your body.
Cut your whole body out to blend with the environment.
A distinctive mask or object makes you memorable.
Shoot your back or footsteps for the whole film.
Only open faces keep memories vivid years later.
pitfalls: Avoid the face at any cost.
AI can change faces, but hiding has its own perks.
Pick props that match your vlog's theme.
Forget the memory value of showing up.
Backs and footsteps are classic alternatives.
You'll only regret filming too little.
shifts: 说露脸只会说 show face
用 split screen（分屏）、cutout（抠图）、cover the face（遮挡脸部）
用 playful fusion（有趣融合）、theme-matched props（贴合主题道具）、part of the environment（环境的一部分）
用 vivid memories（清晰回忆）、truest memories（最真实的回忆）、film more（拍更多）
